full_page.content:
1953, Nov. 25
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
St. Felix Friary Huntington, Indiana
Nov. 25th 1953
Blessed be God in all His designs.
God bless you Patrick Gainer. Many thanks for your favor of several weeks ago. Please pardon delay. I pray for your good will and for God's holy guidance in regard to the important step you have been considering. I am sure that if you go to the holy sacraments frequently and earnestly, God will not let you go astray.
(unfinished)
